description: Deliverable A: the interactive /mkt/ card generator and its data pipeline. A committed Node ESM script copies speaker photos + brand assets into public/mkt/ and emits data.json; a shared card.js draws both 1080x1080 and 1080x1920 layouts on <canvas> using the real theme brand (AWS orange #ff8c00 primary, navy #0d1526 background, Montserrat/Inter fonts, Salvador postcard + community-day logo); a vanilla HTML+JS UI lets the user choose edition/talk, edit title and speaker name, confirm/replace the photo, toggle format, and download a PNG. Must work both in `npm run dev` (publicIndexPlugin at /mkt/) and in the prod dist/. This feature is a prerequisite of FEAT-002.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/context.json and .agents/tasks/plan.md FIRST (absolute paths under /Users/pimenta/community/awscommunitydaybrasil/.worktrees/mkt-card-generator). context.json replaces re-exploration; do not re-derive what it states. Use absolute worktree paths for every file; git ops via `git -C /Users/pimenta/community/awscommunitydaybrasil/.worktrees/mkt-card-generator`.

Create scripts/build-mkt-data.mjs (Node ESM, built-in fs/path only, NO new deps): for regions centro-oeste,nordeste,norte,sudeste,sul (ignore regiaomodelo) read src/regions/<r>/data/speakers.json + config.json; keep speakers with non-empty talk; drop regions with 0 talks (norte); emit one entry per speaker (shared talks => multiple entries); copy each kept photo to public/mkt/photos/<r>/<file>; copy src/assets/logo-community-day.png -> public/mkt/logo-community-day.png and src/regions/nordeste/assets/postcard-salvador.png -> public/mkt/postcard-salvador.png; write public/mkt/data.json as {regions:[{slug,regionName,city,venue,targetDate,eventTime,talks:[{speakerName,talk,photo:'./photos/<r>/<file>',slug}]}]} with slug = accent-stripped lowercased hyphenated speakerName. Idempotent; print a region/card summary. Do NOT modify anything under src/.
Run it from the worktree root: `node scripts/build-mkt-data.mjs`. Commit the generated public/mkt/data.json, public/mkt/photos/**, and the two brand PNGs.

Create public/mkt/card.js (ES module) exporting drawCard(ctx, opts) + helpers (fitText/wrap with auto-shrink-then-ellipsis so titles ALWAYS fit, drawCircleImageCover for cover-fit circular photo, formatDatePtBR -> DD/MM/YYYY). Implement BOTH layouts exactly per plan.md: 1080x1080 (postcard top band + navy scrim, logo top, 300px circular photo center ~ (540,430) with 8px orange ring + glow matching SpeakerCard, title box x[90,990] start 60px Montserrat 700 white max 3 lines, orange speaker name ~44px, muted Inter edition+date line) and 1080x1920 (full-width postcard top 720px with gradient to navy, logo, 420px photo center ~ (540,760), title box x[110,970] start 76px max 4 lines, name ~56px, edition/date line, orange CTA-gradient footer bar with awscommunityday.com.br). Colors/fonts exactly from context.json/plan.md. drawCard is pure (takes loaded Image objects, no DOM lookups) so it is reusable headless.

Create public/mkt/index.html: load Google Fonts Montserrat(400,600,700,800)+Inter(300,400,500,600) via <link>, a <canvas>, controls (edition <select>, talk <select>, editable talk-title <input>, editable speaker-name <input>, photo file <input> + current-photo preview, format toggle square/story, Download button), and <script type="module" src="./app.js">. Use ONLY relative asset paths.

Create public/mkt/app.js (ES module importing ./card.js): fetch ./data.json; populate edition dropdown from data.json regions only (so norte is absent); on edition change populate talk dropdown (option label = `${talk} — ${speakerName}`); pre-fill editable title+name inputs from selection; file input uploads/replaces photo (cover-fit draw); format toggle; preload ./logo-community-day.png + ./postcard-salvador.png + selected ./photos/... as Image objects; await document.fonts.ready before first draw; redraw via drawCard on any input/select/toggle change; Download exports canvas.toBlob PNG named <region>-<speakerSlug>-<format>.png. Also expose window.__renderCardToDataURL({region,slug,format}) that loads the needed images, draws, and returns the canvas dataURL (used by FEAT-002).

Create public/mkt/README.md documenting re-run: `node scripts/build-mkt-data.mjs` (data+assets) and (from FEAT-002) `node scripts/gen-mkt-cards.mjs` (pre-gen cards, needs dev server). Add npm scripts build:mkt-data and gen:mkt-cards to package.json WITHOUT altering existing scripts/deps.

From the worktree: `npm install` (and `npx playwright install chromium` if the browser binary is missing). Then `npm run build`; confirm dist/mkt/{index.html,data.json,card.js,app.js,logo-community-day.png,postcard-salvador.png,photos/nordeste} exist (Vite copies public/).

Runtime check (REQUIRED): `npm run dev` (background, :8080); drive /mkt/ with Playwright (mirror scripts/generate-og-images.ts): wait for data + document.fonts.ready, select edition=Nordeste + a talk, assert <canvas> getImageData is NOT uniform (non-blank), screenshot to .agents/mkt-ui-square.png; toggle story and screenshot .agents/mkt-ui-story.png; click Download and assert page.waitForEvent('download') fires, save to .agents/mkt-download-sample.png. Spot-check a long-title talk fits. Stop the dev server. Do not declare any visual claim satisfied without this runtime check.

Commit locally on branch feat/mkt-card-generator (never push). Set this FEAT status to completed and record in findings: the exact editions emitted, nordeste talk count, the dev-server/Playwright steps used, and the window.__renderCardToDataURL signature so FEAT-002 can call it.
acceptance_criteria: `node scripts/build-mkt-data.mjs` exits 0 and public/mkt/data.json lists exactly regions centro-oeste,nordeste,sudeste,sul (NO norte) with nordeste.talks.length === 17.
`npm run build` exits 0 and dist/mkt/ contains index.html, data.json, card.js, app.js and the brand PNGs + photos.

On a running dev server, /mkt/ renders a non-blank canvas for a Nordeste talk, supports both square and story formats, and the Download button triggers a PNG download (captured via Playwright, screenshots saved under .agents/).
No file under src/ is modified (`git -C <worktree> diff --name-only -- src` is empty).
verification: node -e "const d=require('./public/mkt/data.json');const n=d.regions.find(r=>r.slug==='nordeste');if(d.regions.map(r=>r.slug).sort().join(',')!=='centro-oeste,nordeste,sudeste,sul')throw new Error('editions');if(n.talks.length!==17)throw new Error('nordeste='+n.talks.length);console.log('OK editions + 17 talks')"
test $(ls public/mkt/photos/nordeste/*.jpg | wc -l) -eq 17 && ls public/mkt/logo-community-day.png public/mkt/postcard-salvador.png
npm install && npm run build && ls dist/mkt/index.html dist/mkt/data.json dist/mkt/card.js dist/mkt/app.js dist/mkt/logo-community-day.png
git -C /Users/pimenta/community/awscommunitydaybrasil/.worktrees/mkt-card-generator diff --name-only -- src | (! grep .) && echo 'src untouched'
Playwright runtime check on :8080 asserting non-blank canvas + download event, with .agents/mkt-ui-square.png, .agents/mkt-ui-story.png, .agents/mkt-download-sample.png produced.
findings:
DONE. Editions emitted in public/mkt/data.json (regions present as edition dropdown options): centro-oeste (21 cards), nordeste (17 cards), sudeste (20 cards), sul (11 cards). norte is DROPPED (0 talks); regiaomodelo ignored. Total 69 cards across editions. Nordeste talk count = 17 (acceptance criterion met; includes shared talks: 'Primeiros Passos em Mensageria' x3 Rafael Guerra/Rian Dultra/Victor Mendes and 'Seu Primeiro Workflow com Amazon Rekognition no Free Tier' x2 Izabela Guimaraes/Janaina Ferreira). DATA QUIRK handled: build-mkt-data.mjs resolves photo filename extension mismatches in read-only src (centro-oeste/paloma-lataliza recorded .jpg but is .png; sul/valdeci recorded .jpg but is .jpeg) via resolvePhotoFile() fallback across .jpg/.jpeg/.png/.webp and emits the ACTUAL copied filename in data.json; nordeste photos are all .jpg (17 files in public/mkt/photos/nordeste). Brand assets copied: public/mkt/logo-community-day.png, public/mkt/postcard-salvador.png.

FILES: scripts/build-mkt-data.mjs (data pipeline, Node ESM, fs/path only, idempotent); public/mkt/{card.js,app.js,index.html,data.json,README.md,photos/**,logo-community-day.png,postcard-salvador.png}. npm scripts added to package.json WITHOUT touching existing: 'build:mkt-data' -> node scripts/build-mkt-data.mjs, 'gen:mkt-cards' -> node scripts/gen-mkt-cards.mjs (the gen-mkt-cards.mjs script itself is FEAT-002's deliverable; the npm entry is pre-wired). No new npm deps added. src/ untouched (git diff --name-only -- src empty).

drawCard SIGNATURE (public/mkt/card.js, ES module): drawCard(ctx, { format:'square'|'story', logoImg:Image|null, postcardImg:Image|null, photoImg:Image|null, talk:string, speakerName:string, city:string, dateStr:string }) -> void. Pure (no DOM lookups); caller must size the canvas to FORMATS[format] = { square:{w:1080,h:1080}, story:{w:1080,h:1920} }. Also exported: FORMATS, COLORS, formatDatePtBR(isoOrDate)->'DD/MM/YYYY', drawCircleImageCover(ctx,img,cx,cy,r), fitText(ctx,text,{fontFamily,fontWeight,startSize,minSize,maxWidth,maxLines})->{lines,fontSize} (auto-shrink then ellipsis so titles always fit).

FEAT-002 ENTRY POINT (exact signature, exposed by public/mkt/app.js on window): window.__renderCardToDataURL({ region: string /* region slug e.g. 'nordeste' */, slug: string /* speaker slug from data.json talks[].slug e.g. 'amaury-borges'; first matching entry used for shared talks */, format?: 'square'|'story' /* default 'square' */ }) => Promise<string> resolving to a PNG dataURL ('data:image/png;base64,...'). It awaits document.fonts.ready, loads logo+postcard+photo, draws onto an offscreen canvas sized to FORMATS[format], and returns off.toDataURL('image/png'). window.__mktReady === true signals the page finished its initial load (wait on this before calling). Verified it returns a valid >1KB PNG dataURL at runtime.

DEV-SERVER / PLAYWRIGHT STEPS USED (for FEAT-002 to mirror): npm install; npx playwright install chromium (binary was missing). Ran a temporary harness scripts/verify-mkt-ui.mjs (since DELETED) that: spawn('npm',['run','dev']) cwd=worktree (Vite on http://localhost:8080), polled fetch(BASE_URL+'/mkt/') until 200, then chromium.launch() from '@playwright/test', page.goto('http://localhost:8080/mkt/',{waitUntil:'networkidle'}), waitForFunction(()=>window.__mktReady===true), evaluate(()=>document.fonts.ready), selectOption('#edition','nordeste'), selectOption('#talk', <Open Finance long-title option>), asserted #card-canvas getImageData is non-uniform, screenshot .agents/mkt-ui-square.png; click('#fmt-story') + screenshot .agents/mkt-ui-story.png; Promise.all([page.waitForEvent('download'), page.click('#download')]) -> download.saveAs('.agents/mkt-download-sample.png') (suggestedFilename 'nordeste-joao-santana-story.png', .png asserted); evaluate window.__renderCardToDataURL(...) asserted PNG dataURL. Teardown: browser.close() + dev.kill('SIGTERM'); port 8080 confirmed free afterward. FEAT-002's gen-mkt-cards.mjs should use chromium from '@playwright/test' (same import as scripts/generate-og-images.ts), require the dev server up, and call window.__renderCardToDataURL per nordeste talk to write 17 PNGs 1080x1080 into public/mkt/cards/nordeste/.

VERIFICATION RESULTS: node scripts/build-mkt-data.mjs exit 0; editions assertion + nordeste=17 PASS; 17 jpgs in public/mkt/photos/nordeste + both brand PNGs present; npm run build exit 0 with dist/mkt/{index.html,data.json,card.js,app.js,logo-community-day.png,postcard-salvador.png,photos/nordeste(17)} present; Playwright runtime: square + story canvases non-blank, Download event fired as PNG, long-title (Open Finance) wraps and fits (3 lines square / 4 lines story) verified by eye on the .agents screenshots (Montserrat headings, strong contrast, no overflow). src/ untouched.
